hero.source: NAMA 1428 - Stele of Grave Circle A Mycenae
hero.description:
Funerary stele made of Poros stone with chariot scene relief. Mycenae, Grave Circle A, Grave V. 1500 BC.
National Archaeological Museum of Athens. The spirals in the upper panel may represent waves, thus indicating the coastal location of the scene in the lower panel. The standing charioteer pulls at the reins, while a second figure, who holds a weapon, possibly a sword, in his left hand, is depicted in front of the chariot.
